en.name: Hotel Resol Trinity Hakata
en.catchcopy: Safe, clean, and elegant—ideal for female solo travelers in the heart of Fukuoka.
en.description: Conveniently located just a 1-minute walk from Nakasu-Kawabata Station. This hotel features excellent security, an exclusive ladies-only floor, and a beautiful top-floor public bath. It provides a peaceful retreat while being steps away from Fukuoka's vibrant food scene and Tenjin shopping district.
en.access: 1 min walk from Nakasu-Kawabata Subway Station (Direct from Fukuoka Airport)
